## Page 8

Cus tomer Spotlights : Data Centers in Chonburi & Rayong
8
Dec 2025 : NTT Global Data Centers BKK5 Limited entered into an agreement with 
AMATA to expand its data center and develop Bangkok 5 (BKK5) data center in AMATA 
City Chonburi. The signing of the agreement was led by Mr. Suthipat Lueprasert , Managing 
Director, NTT Global Data Centers (Thailand) Ltd. and Mr. Yasuo Tsutsui, Acting Chief 
Marketing Officer and Chief Executive Officer of Industrial Estate Thailand, AMATA 
Corporation PCL., and was witnessed by senior company executives of both parties. The 
NTT BKK5 data center will become NTT’s Thailand fourth site in the Chonburi industrial area, 
joining BKK2, BKK3, and the previously secured land for BKK4. 
Dec 2025 : THA ASSET CO 1  Limited, a Thai subsidiary of Digital Decarbonization 
Solutions Platform (DDSP), has signed a land purchase agreement with AMATA 
to build a 300MW data center campus in the Amata City Rayong, with RFS (Ready 
for Service) targeted for the first half of 2027. The ceremony was attended by 
Mr. Frederic Devos, CEO of DDSP, and Mr. Satha Vanalabhpatana , Managing Director 
of Amata City Rayong Co., along with senior executives from both organizations.

## Page 25

25
AMATA received ‘AAA’ rating in the SET ESG Ratings 
2025 for the 6thconsecutive year.
AMATA received the highest ‘AAA’ rating in the SET ESG Ratings 2025 sustainable stock assessment 
by the stock exchange of Thailand. Reaffirming its position as a global -standard leader in sustainable 
industrial estate development under ESG principles —environmental, social, and governance —to drive 
balanced and resilient business growth. 
AMATA VN , which is AMATA’s subsidiary managing our investment in Vietnam , also received the ‘AAA’ 
sustainable stock rating for the first time in 2025, reflecting the strong potential of Amata Group in 
expanding its business internationally while continuing to develop industrial estates in alignment with 
global sustainability standards.

Kantima Charoenchaiprasert, Managing 
Director.
